Pianist Shelly Berg was born in Cleveland, Ohio on August 18, 1955. He majored in music at the University of Houston. Currently he is the Chair of Jazz Studies at USC and is Past President of IAJE. Shelly has composed and arranged charts for numerous commercials, film soundtracks and pop groups, and finds time to perform and record with his own ensembles.
Shelly was interviewed in Scottsdale, Arizona on April 15, 2000, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Scottsdale, Arizona. My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Shelly Berg with me at the festival, and you seem to be a guy who wears a lot of different hats.
